# Third-party funding.json schema

`funding-v1.1.0.schema.json` is an **unmodified** copy of the published
[funding.json v1.1.0 schema](https://fundingjson.org/schema/v1.1.0.json), retrieved
2026-11-09. SHA-256:
`bbdfb4e6acbed2f322c4a766c527d760a87a7c21d1d376a570a0c8a2b8512132`.

Source project: [funding.json / FLOSS/fund](https://fundingjson.org/), introduced

This is a separately identified third-party file in a collection. ItF's original
